channel.title: M365 Roadmap Tracker — A Guide to Cloud & AI
channel.description: Daily Microsoft 365 roadmap updates — new features, status changes, and AI summaries

item.title: [STATUS_CHANGED] Outlook: Emails marked with External to be supported as Rules conditions
item.description: [STATUS_CHANGED] The External tag on an email, set by the ExternalInOutlook feature, will now be usable as a condition in Outlook Inbox Rules. This change also makes available the ability to create or modify these Rules on the new Outlook for Windows, Outlook Web, and Outlook for Mac. (GA: June CY2026) — Exchange, Outlook

item.title: [NEW] Microsoft Teams: Multi-line Calling on Teams Mobile
item.description: [NEW] Make and receive calls using multiple assigned phone numbers directly from your mobile device - choose the right line for every call, with unified call history and seamless switching across all your lines. (GA: July CY2026) — Microsoft Teams

item.title: [NEW] SharePoint: Agent Access Insights heatmap for SharePoint and OneDrive sites
item.description: [NEW] Provides a visual heatmap of agent activity to help admins quickly detect patterns, hotspots, and unusual access behavior. (GA: July CY2026) — OneDrive, SharePoint

item.title: [NEW] Microsoft 365 admin center: Notifications for organizational data processing status
item.description: [NEW] With this feature, organizational data source admins receive email notifications when data processing through one of their configured connectors completes successfully or requires attention. Notifications are enabled by default with the option to unsubscribe. (GA: July CY2026) — Microsoft 365 admin center

item.title: [NEW] Outlook: New Outlook for Windows for GCC-H and DoD
item.description: [NEW] The new Microsoft Outlook for Windows will be available for US Government clouds (GCC-H and DoD sovereign environments). (GA: September CY2026) — Outlook

item.title: [DATE_CHANGED] SharePoint: Create Word, Excel, and PowerPoint files with AI
item.description: [DATE_CHANGED] SharePoint users can now use AI to create Word, Excel, and PowerPoint files based on gathered information. This affects all SharePoint users. (GA: December CY2026) — SharePoint

item.title: [DATE_CHANGED] Microsoft Viva: Unlocking Deeper Copilot Insights with Enhanced Power BI Filtering
item.description: [DATE_CHANGED] Global and Insights admins can enable additional filters in Power BI reports for tailored insights in Microsoft Viva. This change affects users generating reports with Power BI. (GA: June CY2026) — Microsoft Viva, Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365)

item.title: [DATE_CHANGED] Microsoft Viva: Copilot Enhanced Topic Assignment
item.description: [DATE_CHANGED] We're upgrading our topic assignment pipeline to be powered by Copilot, delivering significantly improved accuracy in categorizing survey comments into relevant topics. (GA: July CY2026) — Microsoft Viva

item.title: [DATE_CHANGED] Microsoft Purview compliance portal: Scanner data export for custom reporting
item.description: [DATE_CHANGED] The Microsoft Purview compliance portal now allows for custom reporting using data from the information protection scanner. This change impacts compliance officers and admins needing detailed reports. (GA: August CY2026) — Microsoft Purview

item.title: [DATE_CHANGED] OneNote: Summary and Q&A in OneNote Mobile with Copilot (Android)
item.description: [DATE_CHANGED] OneNote mobile for Android will also introduce a summary tool and Q&A feature with Copilot, enhancing information access for users. This affects Android users of OneNote. (GA: June CY2026) — Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365), OneNote

item.title: [UPDATED] Microsoft Purview: Endpoint Data Loss Prevention - Policy Sync & Device Health AI-Powered Investigation
item.description: [UPDATED] AI agent skill to detect and alert unhealthy policy sync and device configuration. (GA: July CY2026) — Microsoft Purview

item.title: [UPDATED] Microsoft 365 admin center: Usage reports – Microsoft 365 Copilot Connectors
item.description: [UPDATED] A new usage report will be available in the Microsoft 365 admin center for Copilot Connectors in Microsoft 365 Copilot, designed to give organizations a detailed view of how connectors are being used within Microsoft 365 Copilot. This report provides insights into overall connector activity, and con (GA: June CY2026) — Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365), Microsoft 365 admin center

item.title: [STATUS_CHANGED] OneNote: Multimodal capture in Copilot Notebooks (iPhone)
item.description: [STATUS_CHANGED] OneNote will introduce multimodal capture in Copilot Notebooks, allowing users to transcribe audio, take images, and type notes in one session. This feature benefits users capturing diverse content. (GA: May CY2026) — OneNote, Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365)

item.title: [STATUS_CHANGED] Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Create Word documents from Copilot Notebooks
item.description: [STATUS_CHANGED] Microsoft Copilot will enable users to generate Word documents from Copilot Notebooks, facilitating the transition from ideas to structured documents. This affects users working with Copilot Notebooks. (GA: May CY2026) — Microsoft 365, OneNote, Microsoft 365 app, Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365)

item.title: [STATUS_CHANGED] Microsoft Purview: DSPM data risk assessments: item-level investigation & remediation
item.description: [STATUS_CHANGED] Microsoft Purview will allow item-level investigation and remediation of SharePoint data, helping users manage overshared items with new insights. This affects SharePoint users and compliance teams. (GA: April CY2026) — Microsoft Purview

item.title: [STATUS_CHANGED] Microsoft Purview compliance portal: Information Protection - Sensitivity label grouping modernization
item.description: [STATUS_CHANGED] The sensitivity labeling scheme in the Microsoft Purview compliance portal will be simplified for better organization and usability. (GA: December CY2025) — Microsoft Purview

item.title: Microsoft Teams: Proximity join support for presenters in Teams events from Teams Rooms on Windows and Android
item.description: Presenters can take advantage of proximity join with Teams Rooms on Windows or Android for fast, effortless connection to nearby room systems during Teams events, such as town halls, webinars, and structured meetings. This feature enables seamless live presentations. (GA: June CY2026) — Microsoft Teams

item.title: Microsoft Teams: Search in quick sharing experience
item.description: Microsoft Teams is enabling search within the quick sharing experience, allowing users to find and attach cloud files more easily. This affects all Teams users sharing files. (GA: June CY2026) — Microsoft Teams

item.title: Microsoft Purview: Endpoint Data Loss Prevention - Enforce DLP protection upon new content before its saved
item.description: Microsoft Purview will enforce DLP protection on unsaved sensitive content, preventing it from being printed or moved. This impacts users handling sensitive information. (GA: May CY2026) — Microsoft Purview

item.title: Microsoft Purview: Endpoint Data Loss Prevention - Expand protection to Copilot + PC devices for Recall snapshots through custom policies
item.description: Microsoft Purview expands DLP protection to Copilot and PC devices, allowing custom policies for Recall snapshots. This affects Purview admins and Intune admins managing these devices. (GA: May CY2026) — Microsoft Purview

item.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Updated chat-first design in the Microsoft 365 Copilot mobile app
item.description: The Microsoft 365 Copilot mobile app will receive a chat-first design update, improving user interface and navigation. This affects all mobile app users. (GA: May CY2026) — Microsoft 365 app, Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365)

item.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Simplifying Content in the Input Box
item.description: The Input Box in Microsoft 365 Copilot will simplify content insertion by displaying it as a pill, not repeating it in prompts. This affects users of the Copilot app. (GA: May CY2026) — Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365)

item.title: Microsoft Teams: Searchable keyboard shortcuts from the dialog in Teams
item.description: Easily find keyboard shortcuts with a new searchable experience in Microsoft Teams. Search by shortcut name or enter part of a key combination directly in the dialog. (GA: June CY2026) — Microsoft Teams

item.title: Microsoft Teams: Quick Share for Images
item.description: Microsoft Teams is adding Quick Share for images, allowing users to easily share visual content in chats and channels. This change affects all Teams users sharing images. (GA: June CY2026) — Microsoft Teams

item.title: Microsoft Purview: Endpoint Data Loss Prevention - Add support of hyperlinks in warn & block toast messages for Edge browser
item.description: Microsoft Purview adds hyperlink support in toast messages for Edge, allowing data officers to direct users to resources when DLP rules are triggered. This change affects data officers managing DLP policies. (GA: May CY2026) — Microsoft Purview

item.title: Outlook: Delimiter setting admin policy
item.description: Admins will be able to define a tenant‑wide default value for the Mail Compose and Reply setting that controls whether commas are used to separate recipients. Updated June 2, 2026: We are in the process of correcting an issue with setting the policy. We expect to complete in mid-June. Thank you for (GA: June CY2026) — Outlook

item.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): [Copilot Search] [Copilot Search] Copilot Chat available when using Copilot Search
item.description: Copilot Chat will be available in the Microsoft 365 Copilot app while using Copilot Search, allowing users to interact with Copilot without losing context. This affects Copilot users. (GA: April CY2026) — Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365)

item.title: Microsoft Teams: Teams room builder in the Pro Management portal
item.description: The Teams room builder is a user-friendly, visually engaging tool to help IT managers design and configure Teams Rooms traditional, signature, and flex meeting spaces. This feature, available in the Teams Rooms Pro Management portal, enables faster design, standards creation, and rollout. With a va (GA: June CY2026) — Microsoft Teams

item.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Teams Meetings in Copilot Notebooks
item.description: Teams meeting content can now be integrated into Copilot Notebooks, allowing users to reference discussions and decisions directly in their projects. This feature enhances the notebook experience for users across Microsoft 365. (GA: June CY2026) — OneNote, Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365)

item.title: Microsoft Teams: Teams Phone Call Transfer Improvements
item.description: Microsoft Teams is enhancing the call transfer process on desktop, making it quicker and more intuitive with fewer steps and transfer suggestions. This change affects all Teams users making calls. (GA: June CY2026) — Microsoft Teams

item.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Create a presentation with Copilot in PowerPoint directly from the PowerPoint Home
item.description: Users can create presentations directly from the PowerPoint Home using Copilot. This change affects all PowerPoint users. (GA: May CY2026) — PowerPoint, Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365)

item.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Create a presentation with Copilot in PowerPoint directly from the PowerPoint Home
item.description: PowerPoint will allow users to create presentations directly from the Home menu using Copilot. This feature affects users who create presentations in PowerPoint. (GA: May CY2026) — PowerPoint, Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365)

item.title: Microsoft Teams: Standardized preview experience for Word, PowerPoint, and Excel files
item.description: Microsoft Teams will provide a standardized preview experience for Word, PowerPoint, and Excel files on mobile devices, improving performance and reliability. This change affects all Teams users on mobile. (GA: June CY2026) — Microsoft Teams

item.title: SharePoint: Updates to SharePoint home sites
item.description: SharePoint home sites will receive updates including a new resources web part and customization options for the Viva Connections experience. This affects SharePoint site administrators. (GA: April CY2026) — SharePoint

item.title: Microsoft Teams: Camera view switching in multi-camera Teams Rooms on Windows
item.description: Teams Rooms on Windows can now switch camera views during meetings using the participant panel or video tile. This feature enhances the meeting experience for users in Teams Rooms. (GA: June CY2026) — Microsoft Teams

item.title: Microsoft Purview: Azure AI Foundry integration with Microsoft Purview for AI
item.description: Microsoft Purview will integrate with Azure AI Foundry, enabling Foundry admins to activate Purview for centralized compliance and governance of AI data. (GA: May CY2026) — Microsoft Purview

item.title: Outlook: User-initiated Copilot insights in classic Outlook
item.description: Outlook will allow users to manually select text and request Copilot for relevant information. This change affects all Outlook users. (GA: June CY2026) — Outlook

item.title: Outlook: Automatically display auto-mapped calendars
item.description: Outlook will automatically display users' auto-mapped calendars when switching to the new Outlook interface. This change affects all Outlook users. (GA: May CY2026) — Outlook

item.title: Microsoft Viva: Organizational Data in Microsoft 365 is now available in GCC-Moderate
item.description: Organizational Data in Microsoft 365 is now available in the GCC-Moderate environment, allowing government cloud customers to use data ingestion capabilities. This change affects government organizations using Microsoft 365. (GA: May CY2026) — Microsoft 365 admin center, Microsoft Viva

item.title: Outlook: LDAP directory support for S/MIME in New Outlook
item.description: Outlook now supports LDAP directories for S/MIME encrypted emails, allowing users to fetch recipient certificates from the configured directory. This change affects users of the new Outlook for Windows. (GA: May CY2026) — Outlook

item.title: OneNote: Summary and Q&A in OneNote Mobile with Copilot (Iphone)
item.description: OneNote mobile for iPhone will feature a summary tool and Q&A capability using Copilot, allowing users to quickly access information. This affects iPhone users of OneNote. (GA: May CY2026) — Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365), OneNote

item.title: Exchange: Dynamic distribution groups now populate membership faster on creation and modification
item.description: Dynamic distribution groups in Exchange Online will now populate membership more quickly upon creation or modification, reducing wait times significantly. This change affects Exchange Online administrators. (GA: May CY2026) — Exchange

item.title: SharePoint: Create charts on pages with AI
item.description: Authors can create interactive charts in SharePoint using AI by describing their desired chart in plain language. This feature affects SharePoint page authors. (GA: May CY2026) — SharePoint, Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365)

item.title: Microsoft Teams: Minimized meeting window enhancements
item.description: Teams will enhance the minimized meeting window experience, allowing users to raise hands and send reactions without restoring the full window. This affects all Teams users during meetings. (GA: May CY2026) — Microsoft Teams

item.title: Outlook: Support for Storing S/MIME Certificates in Contacts in New Outlook
item.description: The new Outlook will enable users to store S/MIME encryption certificates in their Contacts, allowing for easier encrypted email communication. This change affects users of the new Outlook. (GA: May CY2026) — Outlook

item.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Web Link as a Reference in Copilot Notebooks
item.description: Microsoft Copilot will allow users to add web links as references in Copilot Notebooks. This change affects users utilizing Copilot for note-taking. (GA: May CY2026) — Microsoft 365 app, Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365)

item.title: Microsoft Teams: Sharing recap access
item.description: In Microsoft Teams, recording and transcript owners can grant access to specific people for recap links without requests. This change affects users who share recordings and transcripts. (GA: May CY2026) — Microsoft Teams, Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365)

item.title: Microsoft Teams: External Domains Anomalies Report
item.description: Microsoft Teams will introduce an External Domains Anomalies Report to help admins identify unusual interactions with external organizations. This feature is designed for IT admins to monitor security risks. (GA: May CY2026) — Microsoft Teams

item.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Engage private content in M365 Copilot
item.description: M365 Copilot will now use content from private communities and events, ensuring users can only access information they are authorized to see. This affects users utilizing M365 Copilot. (GA: May CY2026) — Microsoft Viva, Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365)

item.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Start writing, coding, and creating with Copilot in Pages
item.description: Microsoft Copilot will enable users to co-create content or code in Pages using the tools menu. This affects users working with Copilot in document creation. (GA: May CY2026) — Microsoft 365 app, Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365)

item.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Mind Maps in Copilot Notebooks
item.description: Mind Maps will be added to Copilot Notebooks, providing interactive visualizations of key topics and relationships. This feature is aimed at enhancing user understanding of notebook content. (GA: May CY2026) — Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365), OneNote

item.title: Microsoft Purview: Insider Risk Management – Ability to create cases without content in IRM
item.description: Insider Risk Management in Microsoft Purview will allow the creation of cases without content, increasing the active case limit to 2000. This change affects administrators managing insider risk cases. (GA: May CY2026) — Microsoft Purview

item.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Surveys Agent and Copilot Chat in Microsoft Forms
item.description: Microsoft Forms now includes Copilot Chat and the Surveys Agent, which assists users in improving forms and analyzing results. This feature is available to users with a Copilot license. (GA: May CY2026) — Forms, Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365)

item.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Create Excel spreadsheets from Copilot Notebooks
item.description: Microsoft Copilot allows users to create Excel spreadsheets from content in Copilot Notebooks, streamlining the process of turning ideas into spreadsheets. This affects users who utilize Copilot Notebooks. (GA: May CY2026) — OneNote, Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365)

item.title: Microsoft Teams: Enable customers to book appointments from a live chat widget on your website
item.description: The Teams live chat widget now allows customers to schedule appointments directly from a business's website. This change affects businesses using the chat widget. (GA: May CY2026) — Microsoft Teams

item.title: SharePoint: Chat one-on-one with SharePoint agents in Teams
item.description: Users can now chat one-on-one with SharePoint agents directly within Teams chat, enhancing support and communication. (GA: May CY2026) — Microsoft Teams, Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365), SharePoint

item.title: Microsoft Teams: Efficiency Mode
item.description: Teams will have an efficiency mode that reduces resource usage on low-performance devices, improving meeting quality. This change affects all Teams users on constrained hardware. (GA: May CY2026) — Microsoft Teams

item.title: Microsoft Teams: Queues app on Teams mobile
item.description: The Queues app will be available on Teams mobile, enabling call representatives to manage call queues and customer interactions on the go. This change affects mobile Teams users handling calls. (GA: May CY2026) — Microsoft Teams

item.title: Microsoft Purview: Endpoint Data Loss Prevention - Device Health Reporting Dashboard
item.description: Microsoft Purview will introduce a Device Health Reporting Dashboard for admins to monitor device health and readiness for policy updates. This change impacts IT administrators. (GA: May CY2026) — Microsoft Purview

item.title: Microsoft Teams: Book future meetings directly from Teams panels
item.description: Teams panels now allow users to book future meetings directly by selecting available time slots from the calendar. This feature is available for Teams Rooms Pro and Shared Device licenses. (GA: May CY2026) — Microsoft Teams

item.title: Outlook: Jump to Any Folder Instantly with Go to Folder
item.description: Outlook introduces a Go to Folder feature that enables users to quickly search and navigate to any mailbox folder by typing part of the folder name. This change affects Outlook users. (GA: May CY2026) — Outlook

item.title: Microsoft Teams: Test your microphone before you join
item.description: Microsoft Teams will allow users to test their microphone and speakers before joining a meeting. This feature helps ensure audio clarity for participants. (GA: May CY2026) — Microsoft Teams

item.title: Microsoft Teams: Identify bots joining your Teams meetings
item.description: Microsoft Teams will allow organizers to see and control external bots trying to join meetings, enhancing meeting security for organizers. (GA: May CY2026) — Microsoft Teams

item.title: Outlook: Instantly Find Rules, Quick Steps, and More by Name
item.description: Outlook introduces a name search feature for managing email automation tools like Rules and Quick Steps, making it easier to find items. This change affects all Outlook users. (GA: May CY2026) — Outlook

item.title: Microsoft Teams: Enhanced issue detection in Teams Rooms on Windows and auto-remediation with Teams Rooms Pro Management.
item.description: Teams Rooms on Windows will improve issue detection and auto-remediation for meeting spaces. This change benefits IT admins by reducing troubleshooting efforts and ensuring room readiness. (GA: May CY2026) — Microsoft Teams

item.title: Microsoft Teams: Room health signals and notifications in Teams Rooms on Windows
item.description: Teams Rooms on Windows will display notifications for critical issues affecting room functionality, helping users resolve problems quickly. This feature is available for Teams Rooms Pro. (GA: May CY2026) — Microsoft Teams

item.title: Microsoft Teams: Improved copy and paste support for @mentions and shared contacts
item.description: Microsoft Teams will now preserve @mentions and shared contacts when copying and pasting messages, improving the accuracy of pasted content. This change affects all Teams users. (GA: May CY2026) — Microsoft Teams

item.title: Microsoft Viva: Copilot Analytics - Onboarding emails for Leaders
item.description: Microsoft Viva will send automated onboarding emails to Leaders to promote the use of the Copilot Dashboard in Viva Insights. (GA: May CY2026) — Microsoft Viva

item.title: Microsoft Teams: Improved organization for muted and meeting chats
item.description: Microsoft Teams will automatically organize muted and meeting chats into dedicated sections, helping users manage their conversations better. This affects all Teams users. (GA: May CY2026) — Microsoft Teams

item.title: Microsoft Teams: Enhanced media quality for Direct Guest Join
item.description: You’ll notice media quality improvements including support for up to 16 participant videos (4×4 grid) available in May and simulcast streaming (June) when using Direct Guest Join. These updates make cross‑platform meetings more immersive and reliable when joining Teams meetings from Zoom, Google Mee (GA: May CY2026) — Microsoft Teams

item.title: Microsoft Teams: Brand Impersonation Protection for Teams Calling
item.description: Teams calling will now include brand impersonation protection to identify potential phishing attempts from external users. This feature impacts enterprise users receiving calls via Teams. (GA: May CY2026) — Microsoft Teams

item.title: Microsoft Teams: Delete meeting generated content in recap
item.description: Meeting organizers in Microsoft Teams can now delete generated content like recordings and transcripts from the recap page using a new delete button. (GA: May CY2026) — Microsoft Teams, Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365)

item.title: Microsoft Teams: Improved keyboard navigation and default line numbers in code blocks
item.description: Microsoft Teams will have improved keyboard navigation and default line numbers in code blocks, making it easier for users to collaborate on code. This change affects all Teams users working with code blocks. (GA: May CY2026) — Microsoft Teams

item.title: Outlook: New and Improved People Hub on Web
item.description: Outlook Web will feature a new People Hub with a modern interface, improved search, and automatic linking of duplicate contacts. (GA: May CY2026) — Outlook

item.title: Microsoft Teams: Miracast support for Teams Rooms on Windows devices
item.description: Teams Rooms on Windows devices will support Miracast for wireless sharing, in addition to existing HDMI options. (GA: May CY2026) — Microsoft Teams

item.title: Microsoft 365 admin center: Organizational Messages now supports Action Segments
item.description: The Microsoft 365 admin center now allows IT admins to target Organizational Messages using dynamic, pre-defined usage segments. This change enhances message targeting for admins. (GA: May CY2026) — Microsoft 365 admin center

item.title: Microsoft 365 admin center: Organizational Messages now supports Email messages
item.description: Organizational Messages in the Microsoft 365 admin center now supports Email as a delivery channel, expanding communication options for admins. This affects how messages are delivered to users. (GA: May CY2026) — Microsoft 365 admin center

item.title: Microsoft Teams: Add Breakout Room Participants in Bulk Using CSV
item.description: Microsoft Teams will allow bulk assignment of breakout room participants using a CSV file, streamlining the setup process for organizers. This feature is relevant for Teams meeting organizers. (GA: May CY2026) — Microsoft Teams

item.title: Microsoft 365 Apps: Cloud Update - Update Health
item.description: Cloud Update will provide enhanced error reporting for Microsoft 365 Apps updates, offering clearer error messages for failed updates. This feature helps admins diagnose issues more efficiently. (GA: May CY2026) — Microsoft 365, Microsoft 365 app

item.title: Microsoft Teams: Catch up on conversations in Microsoft Teams mobile
item.description: Microsoft Teams mobile will provide a unified view of conversations, allowing users to easily catch up on chats and threads, impacting mobile users. (GA: May CY2026) — Microsoft Teams

item.title: Outlook: Copilot provides coaching feedback in chat as you draft, edit and format emails
item.description: Outlook will now feature Copilot providing coaching feedback on email drafts, allowing users to apply suggestions directly. This change impacts all Outlook users drafting emails. (GA: May CY2026) — Outlook, Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365)

item.title: Outlook: Draft, edit and format emails conversationally with Copilot in Outlook
item.description: Outlook will enable users to draft, edit, and format emails conversationally with Copilot, enhancing email composition. This change affects Outlook users. (GA: May CY2026) — Outlook, Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365)

item.title: SharePoint: New SharePoint Experience
item.description: SharePoint is introducing a new experience focused on knowledge discovery and content publishing, with an updated design. This affects all SharePoint users. (GA: May CY2026) — SharePoint

item.title: Outlook: Import emails from PST file to mailbox in new Outlook for Windows
item.description: Users can import emails from PST files into their mailbox in the new Outlook for Windows. This feature will assist users migrating from older Outlook versions. (GA: April CY2026) — Outlook

item.title: Microsoft Teams: Badging updates help find messages that count in the chat list
item.description: Microsoft Teams will now display badges on the app bar to indicate activity in chats and channels, making it easier to find unread messages. This change affects all Teams users. (GA: May CY2026) — Microsoft Teams

item.title: Microsoft Teams: Quick access to read items from unread-only view
item.description: Teams will allow users to filter chat and channel lists to show only unread items, with an eye icon to access read items without leaving the view. This feature impacts all Teams users. (GA: May CY2026) — Microsoft Teams

item.title: Microsoft Teams: Honor Windows Do not disturb setting
item.description: Microsoft Teams will now respect the Windows Do Not Disturb setting, pausing notifications when enabled. This affects all Teams users. (GA: May CY2026) — Microsoft Teams

item.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Branded footer in the Microsoft 365 Copilot app
item.description: The Microsoft 365 Copilot app will introduce a branded footer that displays the organization’s logo and an 'Approved by' label. This change affects administrators managing branding settings. (GA: May CY2026) — Microsoft 365, Microsoft 365 app, Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365)

item.title: Microsoft Teams: Meeting participants can request collaborative annotation sessions
item.description: In Microsoft Teams meetings, participants can request to start collaborative annotation sessions, which require approval from the presenter. Organizers can control who can start annotations through a new Meeting Options setting. (GA: May CY2026) — Microsoft Teams

item.title: Outlook: Account Selector in Outlook Copilot Side Pane
item.description: Outlook adds an account selector in the Copilot side pane for users with multiple accounts, simplifying account management. This change affects users with multiple Copilot-enabled accounts. (GA: May CY2026) — Outlook

item.title: Microsoft Teams: Consecutive interpretation in Interpreter
item.description: Microsoft Teams will introduce consecutive interpretation, allowing turn-based interpretation during meetings for better interaction across languages. This change affects all Teams users participating in multilingual meetings. (GA: May CY2026) — Microsoft Teams, Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365)

item.title: Microsoft Teams: Branded Meeting Reactions
item.description: Microsoft Teams will allow organizations to upload custom branded meeting reactions for participants. This change affects meeting experiences by enhancing brand visibility during meetings. (GA: May CY2026) — Microsoft Teams

item.title: Outlook: Triage your inbox on-the-go with Copilot voice for Outlook mobile
item.description: The Outlook mobile app will feature a Copilot voice experience to help users manage their inbox by summarizing unread emails and allowing actions like flagging or archiving. This change affects users of the Outlook mobile app. (GA: April CY2026) — Outlook, Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365)

item.title: Microsoft Teams: One-time email passcodes for external presenters in Teams events
item.description: Microsoft Teams will implement one-time email passcodes for verifying external presenters, impacting event organizers and tenant administrators. (GA: April CY2026) — Microsoft Teams

item.title: Microsoft Teams: Private channels increased limits and transition to group compliance
item.description: Private channels in Teams will transition to using a shared mailbox, increasing member limits and applying compliance policies. This affects Teams administrators and users managing private channels. (GA: April CY2026) — Microsoft Teams

item.title: Planner: Task chat and mentions in basic plans
item.description: Planner will introduce task chat and mentions in basic plans, enabling team members to collaborate directly on tasks. This change affects users who manage tasks within Planner. (GA: January CY2026) — Planner

item.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Copilot uses enterprise assets hosted on Adobe Experience Manager when creating presentations
item.description: M365 Copilot can create presentations using images from an organization's asset library hosted on Adobe Experience Manager. This change impacts users who connect their asset library to Copilot. (GA: April CY2026) — PowerPoint, Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365)

item.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Copilot uses enterprise assets hosted on Adobe Experience Manager when creating presentations
item.description: M365 Copilot can create presentations using images from an organization's asset library hosted on Adobe Experience Manager. This change impacts users who connect their asset library to Copilot. (GA: April CY2026) — PowerPoint, Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365)

item.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Copilot uses enterprise assets hosted on Adobe Experience Manager when creating presentations
item.description: M365 Copilot can create presentations using images from an organization's asset library hosted on Adobe Experience Manager. This change impacts users who connect their asset library to Copilot. (GA: April CY2026) — PowerPoint, Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365)

item.title: Microsoft Teams: Backup RTMP Support for Teams town halls
item.description: Teams town halls will support a backup RTMP stream to maintain live broadcasts during interruptions. This change affects users hosting town hall events in Teams. (GA: April CY2026) — Microsoft Teams
